name: Reverse Hack Squat
cues: Face the machine with your chest against the pad
Set your feet low enough on the platform that your heels stay down
Push your hips back as you sink
Stand by driving your hips forward into the pad

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Chest on the pad with the trunk 46 deg forward. The hips go back 0.29 m (z 0.188 to -0.097) and the knees end 0.43 m ahead of the heels on a heel-up plate, which matches the cues. Bottom is knee 102 / hip 92, 10 deg shallower than 413 because the back pad was trimmed to 0.30 m. Girdle sinks 41 mm into the pads (tol 50). On the side sheet the face sits right at the near shoulder pad: owner should check the neck extension.
